description: Cuts across multiple tracks in a sequence at an absolute timeline time. If no track arrays are provided, all video and audio tracks are cut.

audioTrackIndices.description: Optional audio track indices to cut. Defaults to all audio tracks.

sequenceId.description: Optional sequence ID. Defaults to the active sequence.

time.description: Absolute timeline time in seconds where the cut should occur.

videoTrackIndices.description: Optional video track indices to cut. Defaults to all video tracks.

name: razor_timeline_at_time
